verdict.rationale: Entra ID is a SaaS identity platform, so an official MCP server for agents to connect to and manage identity resources is a fair axis. The only MCP-related evidence (microsoft-entra-probe-4) points to a generic Microsoft Learn training/documentation MCP server, not an Entra ID-specific server exposing identity/provisioning capabilities to agents — no evidence of an actual Entra ID MCP server exists in the pack.
